## Stage 1 — F2-f (commit 73308a4a, committed green before stage 2)

- `scripts/claims-lexicon.json` — the single banned-phrase source
  (REQ-XF-134, C-25): `banned` (15 entries moved verbatim from
  check-position.sh), `record_banned` (7 §2.7 phrases), `site_banned`
  (§9.4/§8.8 D1+F2 phrases incl. bare `leader` unless
  `observed-`-preceded, plus the phase-4 configuration set),
  `conditional` (significant/tied/improves·improvement/equivalent with
  their allowed-form patterns).
- `scripts/check-position.sh` — reads `banned`/`record_banned` from the
  lexicon, fail-closed on missing/malformed (new negative mutation in
  `test-check-position.sh`: absent lexicon rejected). Byte-identical
  behaviour — the existing battery stayed green throughout.
- `scripts/check-site.sh` — the fourteen §9.4 legs (lexicon,
  conditional, intervals, ranks, availability, provenance, labels,
  no-third-party, a11y-static, links, budgets, determinism, drift,
  hygiene); exit 0 green / 1 leg-fail / 2 usage+malformed; `--head`
  (committed-HEAD clone, check-position precedent) and `--profile`
  internal|public; a caller-built SITE_DIR argument for pages.yml.
  Visible-string extraction covers text nodes (script/style excluded)
  plus text-bearing attributes — SVG `<title>`/`aria-label`/`alt`/
  `title`/`content`/`placeholder` — over every rendered page, committed
  site-data, and the phase-1 record.
- `scripts/ci/test-check-site.sh` — mutations (a)–(v) each fail their
  named leg on a seeded checkout; publication fixtures (one/two/bad
  records) + exit-code legs + real-checkout green. 22 mutations + 5
  fixture legs + seed/head/usage legs.
- `build.py --profile {internal,public}` + `sitepages.build()` —
  internal renders all input content + designed absent pages for every
  §9.2 URL-map path (phase-2/3/4, task grids, trial); public renders a
  phase only where a `hh-site-publication/1` record pins it —
  everything else is `not yet published — publication gate pending`
  with no numbers; `robots.txt` + `noindex` on trial paths
  (REQ-XF-133); `_public_scan` refuses fixture labels, preview banners,
  private dataset hosts and local paths on rendered pages
  (REQ-XF-142).
- `hhsite/publication.py` — `hh-site-publication/1` well-formedness
  (schema/phase/filename, gate-row + readout-file references, inputs
  digest recompute, labels/dataset fields, supersede-by-reference
  ordering), `pin_errors` (input-set match — mismatch is a refusal,
  never a silent re-pin), `manifest_row_errors` (REQ-XF-130).
- Bug fixes the legs surfaced in R6.5's renderer: `<use>` sprite paths
  were relative-wrong on depth ≥1 pages (links leg), card h3s under
  bare h1s skipped heading levels (a11y-static leg). Both fixed at the
  renderer, verified by the legs.
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — `ci-mode: both` check-site step

  anchor pair; `test-check-site.sh` added to the existing self-test

## Notes / ambiguity readings

- The `no-third-party` leg treats `scripts/site/config/origins.json`
  (`hh-site-origins/1`) as the declared origin set — `asset_origins`
  and `dataset_origins` empty while the dataset stays private; any
  `huggingface.co` reference in a rendered page or site-data fails both
  `no-third-party` and `hygiene`. The public build additionally refuses
  at emit time (REQ-XF-142's "refuse" semantics — fail closed, not just
  flagged).
- `[data-src]` elements whose `class` is not `num` may cite provenance
  loosely beside composite display text ("30 executed" beside
  `$0.00`-sha); the leg enforces sha+pointer resolution for all and
  packet-value equality on `num`-marked positions — mutation (g) is
  caught at the site-data layer regardless.
- `[results-site]` evidence card absent → availability prints a note
  and checks phase states against the cards present (owner R6.31/R6.50
  per the contract).
- The `check-ci-gating.sh` `grep: out of memory` warning is
  pre-existing (present before this ticket; the check reports OK).
- `pages.yml` builds `_site` unconditionally — the green
  "nothing published" build is itself the checkable honest state.
